reviewer_scope: Independent of the Python collector/replayer; native extension was implemented by this reviewer and separately inspected by the main agent. This is not an independent replay of native window execution.
code_review: Synchronous C/R nesting uses exact parent request/callback IDs, MAIN TID/TEB and bounded128 callbacks/depth8. CB_RETURN ack1 is separate from the actual callback_result.

Native WindowCallScope releases stateMutex before callback-capable Win32 calls. Callback entry/frame mutation uses a short lock; callbackTls takes a separate short lock. No recursive stateMutex hold spans transport.

Native callbacks expose actual tracked TLS lookup and owned116B PTD bytes with LastError restored. Current offline records explicitly have model TID123/TEB456 and absentTLS; they do not prove fresh ownership.
Guest callback uses an independent stack/shadow per depth, enforces original stdcall/callee-saved return, restores the full saved CPU57 context and scratch, and rejects untransported lParam writes.

CreateWindow class/title retain guest7A2628 with explicit native read-only class-string projection. CREATESTRUCT lpCreateParams preserves opaque original guestMAIN. GetWindowLong(-4) reverse projection is explicit.

Preparation uses owned13B name/16B RECT/48B class buffers and records every temporary release on success. Failure before release remains explicitly pending and requires Job containment; it is not normal resource cleanup.

Native class/window/module ownership prevents freeing resources while in use; shutdown rejects live window resources. DestroyWindow requires actual success,IsWindowfalse and WM_NCDESTROY before class/module release.
limitations: No helper, window, desktop, input, screenshot or game execution was performed by this work. The new executable is compiled but unexecuted.

The reviewer compared recorded callback sequences, source import bytes, result/ABI and CPU restoration snapshots. It did not rerun the collector or independently recompute full instruction/memory/write digests.
MAIN-byte equivalence and temporary model emptiness are supported by the retained source and reviewed replay assertions, not fresh native evidence.
The offline fixture resumes an existing MAIN state at49DE2C; it is not cold WinMain entry or complete original startup.

ShowWindow/UpdateWindow and full WM_PAINT/input/device/audio routes remain outside current Python callback admission. Native window cleanup, desktop restoration, GAME publication, cooperative wait and result consumption remain unproved.
Two recorded A5/CC cases are not two new native lifetimes; all existing formal acceptance requirements remain unchanged.
